name: ftp
description: 2.11BSD ftp(1) runs its command loop from a staged script, so every needle is ftp's output and never the typed command.  `help' prints the command table from cmdtab.c; `status' reports the defaults, including PORT mode; `passive' toggles the passive mode taken from 4.4BSD-Lite2, which starts on, so it reports off; and `open 127.0.0.1 21' goes through socket(2) and connect(2) on loopback, where nothing listens, and is refused.  No server is involved, so nothing is transferred.
